changeSet.author: kabipay-dev
changeSet.comment: Repair linked login users disabled when an employee entered the temporary ON_LEAVE status.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE "${schema}"."user" AS login_user SET is_active = TRUE, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM "${schema}".employee AS employee WHERE employee.tenant_id = login_user.tenant_id AND employee.user_id = login_user.id AND employee.is_deleted = FALSE AND employee.status = 'ON_LEAVE' AND login_user.is_deleted = FALSE AND login_user.is_active = FALSE;
